display_name: Acknowledge a rendered role inbox page
description: After a consumer has successfully written and flushed a peer_inbox role page, acknowledge its opaque page token. This creates exact per-instance display receipts only for server-issued page items; it is not proof that a model consumed or acted on them.
embedding_description: Acknowledge a role inbox page only after its complete merged output has been written and flushed. Submit the server-issued opaque page token to create immutable, exact display receipts for the calling session and instance; retrying the same acknowledgement preserves the original receipt facts.
